thread:
Elena: Windward pilot blocked: Rust SDK SSE handshake + function-calls not cooperating with their on-prem connector. Need quick workaround + pricing and security checklist.
Sam: Rust client has SSE but function-calls are experimental. Recommend edge-proxy shim that translates tool-call frames to webhooks.
Sam: Shim sketch:
```rust
// pseudo
let mut s = client.stream(req).await?;
while let Some(chunk) = s.next().await {
  if chunk.is_toolcall() { forward_to_webhook(chunk).await? } else { send_downstream(chunk).await? }
}
```
Priya: Procurement asked for hosted vs 12mo Dedicated comparison for ~100 RPS @ ~1.2k tokens/req. Need assumptions included.
Ben: Quick note: hosted gen tier ~ $0.00075-0.0009/token depending on model; 100 RPS @1.2k tokens ~=120k tokens/sec. Dedicated (1 GPU reserved) likely better at that scale; will model scenarios and TCO. Also calling out egress and on-prem fees.
Elena: Security asks: KMS integration, SAML SSO, audit logs, cert pinning. We have SOC2 + KMS guide; Ben to extract a 1-page checklist.
ops-bot: Created ticket WD-4219 for on-prem creds/runbook (assignee: Elena).
Sam: Short-term plan: Windward runs Rust client unchanged; we deploy edge-proxy in their DMZ to terminate SSE and translate toolcalls to their webhook handler. Config example:
```
edge_proxy:
  listener: 0.0.0.0:443
  mode: sse
  forward_toolcalls: true
  webhook: http://localhost:8080/tool
  tls: terminate
```
Elena: Action items: Sam = sample repo + proxy config, Ben = pricing + security checklist draft, Priya = procurement one-pager. Send consolidated reply to Windward EOD tomorrow.
Priya: I can join the infra call if needed.
Elena: Thanks, will attach ticket and follow up. :thumbsup:
